points: 1 Scope and claims: open models at 1B/4B/12B/27B. Vision is on 4B and up; the 1B is text-only. Context is 128K (32K for the 1B), with wider multilingual coverage. All models are trained by distillation. The abstract claims Gemma3-4B-IT is competitive with Gemma2-27B-IT and Gemma3-27B-IT is comparable to Gemini-1.5-Pro.

2 Architecture and long context: decoder-only with GQA, pre- and post-norm RMSNorm, and QK-norm in place of Gemma 2's soft-capping. Local sliding-window and global layers interleave 5:1, with a 1024-token window and a local first layer, to cut the KV cache. RoPE base is 1M on global layers and 10k on local layers. Pre-training uses 32K sequences; the 4B/12B/27B are then rescaled with RoPE by a factor of 8 to 128K. Quality degrades beyond 128K.

3 Vision: a frozen 400M SigLIP encoder at 896x896, shared by 4B/12B/27B. Images become 256 tokens (4x4 average pooling), and embeddings are precomputed for training. Pan & Scan is inference-only cropping. Ablations: resolution 256 to 896 lifts DocVQA from 31.9 to 59.8 (short-schedule 2B). P&S lifts 27B InfoVQA from 59.4 to 76.4 (+17.0) and 4B DocVQA from 72.8 to 81.0.

4 Pre-training: 14T/12T/4T/2T tokens for 27B/12B/4B/1B, slightly more than Gemma 2. More monolingual and parallel multilingual data. Gemini 2.0 SentencePiece tokenizer with 262k entries, while the Table 1 caption says 256k. Distillation samples 256 logits per token, weighted by teacher probability, and renormalises. The teacher and the data mixture are not disclosed.

5 Post-training: distillation from a large IT teacher, then RL based on improved BOND, WARM and WARP. Rewards come from weight-averaged reward models, code-execution feedback and math ground truth. Data is filtered. No data sizes, hyperparameters or ablation of the recipe are given.

6 QAT: about 5,000 steps producing per-channel int4, per-block int4 and switched fp8. For 27B, memory is 54.0 GB in bf16 vs 14.1 GB in int4, and 72.7 vs 32.8 GB with a 32K KV cache (Table 3). No quality numbers are reported for the quantized models.

7 Chatbot Arena: Gemma-3-27B-IT scores Elo 1338, rank 9, as of March 8, 2025 (preliminary). This is above DeepSeek-V3 (1318), Llama-3.1-405B (1269) and Gemma-2-27B (1220). The text misattributes 1257 to 'LLaMA 3 405B' and 'Qwen2.5-70B'.

8 Gains over the predecessor (Table 6): Gemma 3 27B-IT vs Gemma 2 27B-IT scores MATH 89.0 vs 55.6, HiddenMath 60.3 vs 14.8, MMLU-Pro 67.5 vs 56.9, LiveCodeBench 29.7 vs 20.4, GPQA Diamond 42.4 vs 34.3.

9 Abstract claims checked against Table 6: 27B-IT trails Gemini-1.5-Pro on most rows (MMLU-Pro 67.5 vs 75.8, GPQA 42.4 vs 59.1, SimpleQA 10.0 vs 24.9). It leads only on MATH and HiddenMath. 4B-IT beats Gemma2-27B-IT on math and FACTS but loses on MMLU-Pro, LiveCodeBench and Global MMLU-Lite. External models are deliberately excluded from static benchmarks.

10 Ablations, figure-only: a local:global ratio up to 7:1 and shorter windows have minimal perplexity impact (text-only). KV-cache overhead at 32K is 60% for global-only vs under 15% for 1:3 with sw=1024; the paper reports 1:3, not the 5:1 used. A smaller teacher is better for short training horizons, but a larger teacher wins for longer ones.
